spans.quote: The trial report should retain the 24-request denominator when presenting the change in median time.

decisions.human_alternative: 업무 분야에서 denominator를 관측 집합의 크기로 넓게 쓰거나, 24건이라는 제한을 결과와 함께 남기려는 사람이 이런 표현을 선택할 수 있다. 대상 독자에게 익숙하다면 유지해도 된다.
decisions.reason: Make the sample size explicit for a general reader, retaining the report duty, 24 requests and median comparison.

applied_replacement.before: The trial report should retain the 24-request denominator when presenting the change in median time.
applied_replacement.after: The trial report should make clear that the change in median time is based on 24 requests.

spans.quote: Across 24 requests, the June archive trial reduced median lookup time from 18 minutes to 11 minutes, although we did not record the longest lookup time.
The trial covered only material that had already been catalogued, so the results do not establish how the system will work with uncatalogued material.

decisions.human_alternative: 실무 담당자가 제한된 시범 결과를 과장하지 않으려 관측치와 누락된 지표, 적용 범위를 함께 적는 문체와 양립한다.
decisions.reason: Distinct factual, voice or operational function; no concrete reader problem requires changing it.
